🎙️ kingdom Gramophone | We Want to Hear Your TH
Story

It’s hard to believe that Top Heroes has been with us
for three years already.
When did you first join us?
Maybe you’ve been here since the very beginning,
or perhaps you joined by chance somewhere along
the way.
Maybe you started playing just for fun,
but ended up meeting a group of friends to fight
battles, chat, and stay up late with.

We come from different countries and speak different
languages.
Sometimes we stumble over our words,
and sometimes our different habits lead to funny
“cultural clashes.”
But it’s these little moments and unexpected
encounters
that make our time in the game so special.

🎙️ As we celebrate the 3rd Anniversary, kingdom
Gramophone wants to hear your story.

It doesn’t have to be a big or epic story.
Even a little moment is enough—as long as it’s your
story, we want to hear it.

🎁 Submission Rewards

🌟 Warm Story Award — Unlimited Winners
Every selected story will receive Gold Blocks worth
$9.99!

💛 kingdom Gramophone Feature Award
The most touching stories will have a chance to be
featured on kingdom Gramophone, along with an
additional reward of 49.99 Gold Blocks + 9,999
Diamonds! 🎁

📅 Event Period: Now– 11th September
📝 How to Submit:
Click the link below to share your TH story! Don’t
forget to include your in-game name and server ID
when submitting.

🎙️ Come tell us your Top Heroes story!
